y-m-70-09.topic: Qaybaha koonka: meelaha parabola iyo xariiq, xariiqyada taabanaya
y-m-70-09.goal: Ka xukun sheegashada 'haddii ay hal dhibic ku kulmaan, waa taabane' adigoo isticmaalaya caddayn shaxda ku jirta oo raadi tusaale lid ku ah, adigu samee lammaano (m, n) bixiya xariiqyo taabanaya oo parabola ah, oo sharax kiiska kala saaraha uusan kala saari karin.
y-m-70-09.material:
Waxaa jira parabola C: y²=4x iyo xariiq l_m: y=mx+1 (m waa tiro dhab ah). (y² waxaa loo akhriyaa "y labajibbaaran".) Jisu ayaa yidhi, "Xariiq parabola ku kulma hal dhibic oo keliya waa xariiq taabanaysa." Natiijooyinka ku beddelidda xariiqda isleegga C iyo fududaynta, iyo dhibcaha isgoyska, waa kuwa hoose.
m | isleegga kadib beddelka | isgoyska
−1 | x²−6x+1=0 | laba dhibcood
0 | −4x+1=0 | hal dhibic (1/4, 1)
1 | x²−2x+1=0 | hal dhibic (1, 2)
2 | 4x²+1=0 | midna
Fiiro gaar ah: Xariiqda taabanaysa ee dhibic (x₁, y₁) ee C ku taal waa y₁·y=2(x+x₁) (qaaciidada xariiqda taabanaysa).

y-m-70-02.s.s1.prompt: Si PF′ loogu go'aamiyo hal qiime, maxaa kale oo loo baahan yahay marka laga reebo waxa hadda la yaqaan?
y-m-70-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ereyo ku qor waxa 'qiimaha joogtada ah' ee qeexidda ellipse yahay.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ilaali PF=7 oo ka fikir ellipse wadarkiisu yahay 12 iyo mid wadarkiisu yahay 20, oo isbarbar dhig waxa PF′ noqon lahaa mid walba.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.o.a: Masaafada FF′ ee u dhaxaysa labada diirad (qiimahan oo keliya ayaa lagu daray)
y-m-70-02.s.s1.r.a: Xataa in la ogaado kaliya masaafada u dhaxaysa diiradaha ma go'aamiyo waxa wadarka masaafooyinku yahay. Xataa isla diiradaha waxaa jira ellipse badan oo cabbirro kala duwan leh.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.o.b: Isku-xidhka y ee barta P (qiimahan oo keliya ayaa lagu daray)
y-m-70-02.s.s1.r.b: Hal isku-xidh oo P ah keligiis ma sheegi karo booska diiradaha ama cabbirka ellipse. Ma jirto wax ku filan oo lagu xisaabiyo PF′.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.o.c: Dhererka dhidibka weyn ee ellipse (ama isla'egta ellipse)
y-m-70-02.s.s1.r.c: Kani waa qiimaha sheegaya waxa wadarka masaafooyinka labada diirad ee ellipse-kan lagu go'aamiyey.
y-m-70-02.s.s1.o.d: Wax kale looma baahna. PF′ sidoo kale waa 7
y-m-70-02.s.s1.r.d: Ma ogtid barta kee tahay, haddana waxaad go'aamisay inay isla masaafo ka fog tahay labada diirad. Xaggee ayay P ahaan lahayd si PF=PF′?
y-m-70-02.s.s1.explain: PF+PF′ waa isla qiime (dhererka dhidibka weyn) bar kasta oo ellipse ku taal. Haddii aadan aqoon qiimahaas, PF=7 keliya ma go'aamiyo PF′. FF′ ama hal isku-xidh P keligiis sidoo kale ma go'aamiyo wadarka, dejinta PF′=PF na waa sax kaliya marka P ay ku taal xariijinta toosan ee dhexda labada diirad.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.prompt: Hadda ellipse x²/25 + y²/9 = 1 waa la bixiyey. Diiradaha waa F(4, 0) iyo F′(−4, 0). (Dhidibka weyn ee badhkiis 5, dhidibka yar ee badhkiis 3, 4²=5²−3²) Baraha kee P ee ellipse-kan ayay PF=7 ka dhici kartaa?
y-m-70-02.s.s2.hint.0: Xisaabi PF geeska midig (5, 0) iyo geeska bidix (−5, 0) si aad u hesho qiimaha ugu yar iyo ugu weyn ee PF.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi in 7 ay ku jirto kala duwanaanshahaas, kadibna hel PF′ adigoo isticmaalaya wadarka masaafooyinka.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.a: Xalkani wuxuu barta u qaatay inay isla masaafo ka fog tahay labada diirad. Barta noocaas ah, PF=PF′=5 ayaa loo baahan lahaa.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.b: Xukunkani wuxuu u isticmaalay dhererka dhidibka weyn sida wadarka masaafooyinka.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.o.c: Suurtagal maaha. PF ma dhaafi karo badhka dhidibka weyn 5
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.c: Badhka dhidibka weyn waa masaafada laga bilaabo xarunta ilaa geeska. Waa cabbir ka duwan masaafada laga bilaabo diirad ilaa bar ellipse ku taal.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.r.d: Waxay u egtahay inaad dhererka 10 ee dhidibka weyn ku simatay farqiga labada masaafo, ma aha wadarka.
y-m-70-02.s.s2.explain: Dhererka dhidibka weyn waa 10, sidaa darteed PF+PF′=10. PF waa 5−4=1 geeska ugu dhow iyo 5+4=9 geeska ugu fog, sidaa darteed wuxuu qaadan karaa qiime kasta 1 iyo 9 dhexdooda. 7 waxay ku jirtaa kala duwanaanshahaas, markaas PF′=10−7=3.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.prompt: Isla ellipse-kan, samee 3 lammaane la hagaajiyey (p, q) oo runtii ay bar P jirto leh PF=p iyo PF′=q. (Isweydaarsiga p iyo q waxaa loo tiriyaa isla tusaale. Waxaad isticmaali kartaa tobanaadyo.)
y-m-70-02.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore qor waxa p+q ay tahay inay noqoto, kadibna hubi haddii doorashada hal p ay go'aamiso q.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.hint.1: Isku day p ka yar 1 ama ka weyn 9 oo ka fikir haddii bar noocaas ah runtii ay ellipse ku taal karto.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.ok.c1: Wadarka labada masaafo waa 10, dhererka dhidibka weyn.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.fail.c1: p+q maaha 10. Waa maxay wadarka masaafooyinka labada diirad ee ellipse-kan?
y-m-70-02.s.s3.ok.c2: Waxay ku jirtaa kala duwanaanshaha masaafooyinka bar ellipse ku taal uu yeelan karo.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.fail.c2: Masaafada laga bilaabo bar ellipse ku taal ilaa diirad ma ka yaraan karto 1. Xusuuso masaafada geeska ugu dhow.
y-m-70-02.s.s3.explain: p+q=10, qiimaha PF na wuxuu ka bilaabmaa 1 (geeska ugu dhow) ilaa 9 (geeska ugu fog), sidaa darteed p iyo q labaduba waa inay ugu yaraan yihiin 1. Dhammaan lammaanayaasha la hagaajiyey ee leh p 1 iyo 9 dhexdooda, sida (3, 7), (5, 5) iyo (1, 9), waa suurtagal.

y-m-70-04.title: Haddii wax-ku-dhufashada dhibcaha ay isle'eg yihiin, labada vector sidoo kale ma isle'eg yihiin?
y-m-70-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a·b iyo a·c waa le'eg yihiin.
y-m-70-04.prereq.0: U qaado in ardaygu qaadanayo koorsada dooran ee dugsiga sare 'Joomatari'. 'H2' waa heer adag iyo taageero oo hawshan soo saarista oo keliya; macnaheedu maaha in Wasaaraddu koorsadan u qoondeyso sannad gaar ah.
y-m-70-04.topic: Vector-yada sagxadda: sifooyinka wax-soo-saarka dot iyo tusaalayaal lid ku ah
y-m-70-04.goal: Ku tijaabi tusaale lid ku ah haddii xeerka baabi'inta ee u shaqeeya tirooyinka ('haddii ab=ac iyo a≠0 markaas b=c') uu sidoo kale u shaqeeyo wax-soo-saarka dot ee vector-yada, oo hel shuruudaha ka dhigaya inuu run noqdo.
y-m-70-04.material: Tirooyinka, haddii a≠0 iyo ab=ac, markaas b=c. Jeonghyeok wuxuu u maleeyey vector-yadu si isku mid ah ayay u shaqeeyaan wuxuuna yiri: "Marka a=(2, 1), haddii a·b=a·c markaas b=c." (a·b waa wax-soo-saarka dot ee a iyo b, taasi waa, qiimaha aad hesho marka aad isku dhufato qaybaha oo aad isku darto. Dhammaan vector-yadu waxay ku yaalaan sagxadda isku-xidhka.)
y-m-70-04.thinking.0: Shakiga ah in xeer tirooyin ah loo wareejin karo waxyaabo kale
y-m-70-04.thinking.1: Naftaada dhisidda tusaale lid ku ah oo buuxiya shuruudaha
y-m-70-04.thinking.2: Tijaabinta haddii shuruudaha dheeraadka ahi ku filan yihiin
y-m-70-04.prereq.1: Qaabka qaybaha ee vector-yada sagxadda iyo wax-soo-saarka dot a·b=a₁b₁+a₂b₂
y-m-70-04.prereq.2: Sifooyinka wax-soo-saarka dot marka laba vector isbarbar yihiin ama toosan yihiin
y-m-70-04.s.s1.prompt: Si loo ogaado haddii hadalka Jeonghyeok had iyo jeer run yahay, kee (b, c) ayaa ugu waxtar badan in la tijaabiyo?
y-m-70-04.s.s1.hint.0: Marka sheegasho leedahay qaabka 'haddii shuruud markaas gunaanad', maxay tahay inay buuxiso oo maxay tahay inay jebiso tusaalaha jebinaya sheegashada, shuruudda mise gunaanadka?
y-m-70-04.s.s1.hint.1: Marka hore dooro hal vector oo wax-soo-saarkiisa dot ee a=(2, 1) la yaqaan, kadibna beddel qaybihiisa oo raadi vector kale oo wax-soo-saarkiisa dot uu isku mid ahaado.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.a: Tijaabi lammaane badan halka b iyo c ay yihiin isla vector
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.a: Haddii b=c, a·b=a·c had iyo jeer waa run. Kuwani ma aha lammaane jebin kara sheegashada.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.b: Tijaabi vector-yo leh isla jihada a oo keliya
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad tijaabinaysaa kiis gaar ah oo keliya. Xataa haddii halkaas run yahay, ma ogaan kartid kuwa kale.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.c: Cabbirku si toos ah ugu xidhna maaha in sheegashadani run tahay.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.o.d: Raadi lammaane leh a·b=a·c iyo b≠c
y-m-70-04.s.s1.r.d: Maadaama sheegashadu leedahay 'had iyo jeer', fikirkani wuxuu raadiyaa lammaane buuxiya shuruudda laakiin ka soo horjeeda gunaanadka.
y-m-70-04.s.s1.explain: Sheegasho 'had iyo jeer' ah waxaa jebiya hal lammaane oo buuxiya shuruudda (a·b=a·c) iyadoo ka soo horjeeda gunaanadka (b=c). Sidaa darteed waxa ugu waxtarka badan waa inaad naftaada raadiso lammaane noocaas ah.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.prompt: A=(2, 1), samee 2 lammaane oo vector-yo ah b=(b₁, b₂), c=(c₁, c₂) leh a·b=a·c laakiin b≠c. Labada lammaane waa inay lahaadaan b−c kala duwan (isweydaarsiga b iyo c, ama beddelidda calaamadda b−c oo keliya, waxaa loo tiriyaa isla tusaale).
y-m-70-04.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore dooro hal b oo xisaabi a·b.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.hint.1: Eeg intee le'eg ayuu a·c u beddelmo marka aad beddesho hal qayb oo c ah, kadibna qaybta kale si ku habboon u beddel si aad wax-soo-saarka dot dib ugu soo celiso.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Si gooni ah u xisaabi a·b=2b₁+b₂ iyo a·c=2c₁+c₂. Labada qiime isle'eg ma aha.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.ok.c2: b iyo c waa vectors kala duwan.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.fail.c2: b iyo c waa isla vector. Waa inay kala duwanaadaan si ay u noqdaan tusaale ka hortag ah.
y-m-70-04.s.s2.explain: Tusaale: haddii b=(1, 3), c=(2, 1), markaas a·b=2+3=5 iyo a·c=4+1=5 waa le'eg yihiin laakiin b≠c. b−c mar walba wuxuu soo baxaa qaabka (t, −2t), jiho u taagan a. Sidaas darteed waad dhaqaajin kartaa vector qadar kasta jihada u taagan a.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.prompt: Waxaad xaqiijisay in sheegashadu mar walba aysan run ahayn. Dooro dhammaan shuruudaha dheeraadka ah ee soo socda ee ka dhigaya 'haddii a·b=a·c markaas b=c' run. (a ma aha vector eber.)
y-m-70-04.s.s3.hint.0: U dib qor shuruud kasta sida vector noocee ah b−c ay tahay inay noqoto. Maxay a·(b−c)=0 ka dhigan tahay?
y-m-70-04.s.s3.hint.1: Shuruud kasta, si toos ah u raadi lammaane b≠c marka a=(2, 1). Haddii aad hesho mid, shuruuddaas ma ku filna.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.a: Isla cabbir yeelashadu ma ka dhigto isla vector. Hubi haddii b=(1, 3), c=(3, −1) buuxiyaan shuruudda marka a=(2, 1).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.o.b: a·b=a·c waa run vector a kasta oo fidsanka ah
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.b: Fikirkani wuxuu beddelaa a halka shuruudda lagu soo rogayo si b−c ay u taagan tahay jiho kasta.
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad seegtay in ay jiraan vectors aan dhammaad lahayn oo u taagan a hal xariiq. Tusaale ahaan, ka fikir (1, −2) iyo (2, −4).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.o.d: b iyo c labaduba is-barbar-socdaan a
y-m-70-04.s.s3.r.d: Fikirkani wuxuu isticmaalaa xaqiiqada ah vectors hal xariiq ku yaal waxaa mid mid lagu hagaajiyaa cabbirkooda (wax-isku-dhufashada dot).
y-m-70-04.s.s3.explain: Maadaama a·(b−c)=0, waxay ku filan tahay b−c inay u taagan tahay a. (b) Haddii ay run tahay a kasta, markaas b−c wuxuu u taagan yahay jiho kasta, sidaas darteed waa vector eber. (d) Haddii b=sa iyo c=ta, markaas s|a|²=t|a|² waxay siinaysaa s=t. (a) Haddii b=(1, 3), c=(3, −1), cabbirradu waa le'eg yihiin iyo a·b=a·c=5, laakiin b≠c. (c) (1, −2) iyo (2, −4) labaduba waxay u taagan yihiin a sidaas darteed wax-isku-dhufashadooda dot waa 0, laakiin midba midka kale way ka duwan yihiin.
